subject: Post-call: Novacorp discovery — next steps & multi-TZ sync carousel
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novacorp.com>, Peter Liu <peter.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Novacorp discovery — next steps & multi-TZ sync carousel

Hi Emma / Peter —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really useful to understand NovaCorp's latency targets for document search and the multi-region compliance constraints for Germany and Singapore. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Key takeaways: low-latency embeddings for search (P95 < 200ms), retention 30 days, SOC2 evidence request.
- Primary goal for next meeting: technical deep dive (architecture + integration approach) + a short demo of our latency profile on your sample corpus.

To make scheduling easier across your EU and APAC stakeholders, I sketched a lightweight rotating "sync-carousel" approach that minimizes one-off scheduling friction:

Option A — Weekly rotating window (recommended):
  - Week 1: US-friendly morning (PDT 08:00–09:30)
  - Week 2: EU midday (CET 13:00–14:30)
  - Week 3: APAC evening (SGT 21:00–22:30)
  - Repeat. Each session = 90 minutes to allow demo + integration Q&A.

Option B — Fixed alternating with overlap:
  - Alternate US/EU weeks, with APAC on-demand overlap calls; shorter 60-minute sessions for focused teams.

Concrete next-step proposals (pick one):
  1) Tue 2028-07-03 13:00–14:30 CET (EU slot)
  2) Thu 2028-07-05 08:30–10:00 PDT (US slot)
  3) Mon 2028-07-09 21:00–22:30 SGT (APAC slot)

If Option A works, we can set a weekly recurring invite with rotating timezones and include a pre-read (we'll attach an agenda + playbook). I attached our discovery notes and a draft agenda for the deep dive.

Please let me know: (a) which option you prefer, (b) which of the three slots works best for your team, and (c) who from NovaCorp should be on the invite for the deep-dive (engineer(s), infra, security).

Thanks — looking forward to taking this to the technical layer.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), tech-deep-dive-agenda.md (draft)

Thanks, Olga — great recap.

We're aligned with the objectives and like Option A (weekly rotation) because it spreads the load across our regional teams and keeps the same meeting for continuity. For the initial deep dive please include our platform lead (Rajiv Kumar) and security lead (Clara Müller).

Of the concrete slots you listed, #1 (Tue 2028-07-03 13:00–14:30 CET) looks best for the EU stakeholders — can you confirm that time will be the EU week in the rotation if we go with Option A?

Also prefer the 90-minute format for the first session; we can tighten to 60 for follow-ups.

Emma
